sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Identify perfective verbs formed with prefixes

items.prompt: What is the perfective of писать (to write)?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective of писать (to write)?
items.hint: The pure prefix that just adds 'completion' to writing.
items.explanation: Написать is the pure perfective pair. Записать (write down), дописать (finish writing), переписать (rewrite) are different verbs.

items.prompt: What is the perfective of делать (to do/make)?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective of делать?
items.hint: Which prefix simply means 'completed the doing'?
items.explanation: Сделать is the pure perfective pair. Переделать (redo), доделать (finish doing) change the meaning.

items.prompt: Она _____ красивую картину. (She drew a beautiful picture.) - completed
items.hint: Completed picture = perfective. Рисовать → на + рисовать.
items.explanation: Completed result: нарисовала (perfective of рисовать, prefix на-).

items.prompt: Мы долго _____ этот дом. (We built this house for a long time.) - process
items.promptEnglish: We built this house for a long time. (process)
items.explanation: Долго (a long time) = process/duration = imperfective: строили.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ обед. (I cooked lunch.) - I finished it
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I cooked lunch. (it's done, ready to eat)
minimalPairs.explanation: Focus on completion = perfective: приготовил (prefix при-).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ обед. (I was cooking lunch.) - process
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I was cooking lunch. (still in progress or general statement)
minimalPairs.explanation: Focus on the process, not result = imperfective: готовил.

minimalPairs.context: Студент _____ все правила. (The student learned all the rules.) - result
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student learned all the rules. (mastered them)
minimalPairs.explanation: Все (all) + completed mastery = perfective: выучил (prefix вы-).

minimalPairs.context: Студент целый год _____ правила. (The student studied the rules all year.) - process
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student studied the rules all year long.
minimalPairs.explanation: Целый год (all year) = long process = imperfective: учил.

blanks: Он уже _____ книгу. (He already read the book.)
Она каждый день _____ картины. (She draws pictures every day.)
Мы наконец _____ ремонт. (We finally finished the renovation.)
hints: Уже = completed = perfective. Читать → про + читать.
Каждый день = repetition = imperfective. Рисовать stays as is.
Наконец = completed = perfective. Делать → с + делать.
explanations: Каждый день = habitual. Imperfective present: рисует.

sets.title: Sort and Match
sets.description: Sort verbs by aspect and match pairs

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Imperfective (base verb) or Perfective (with prefix)?

patternRecognition.question: What prefix do all these perfective verbs share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All three use the prefix с-: сделать (do), сварить (cook), сыграть (play).

patternRecognition.question: What prefix do all these perfective verbs share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All three use the prefix на-: написать (write), нарисовать (draw), напечатать (print/type).

patternRecognition.question: Are these all aspect pairs of писать?
options: No, these are different verbs with changed meanings
Yes, they are all perfective forms of писать
patternRecognition.answer: No, these are different verbs with changed meanings
patternRecognition.explanation: Only написать is the pure pair. Записать (write down), переписать (rewrite), дописать (finish writing), подписать (sign) are different verbs.

errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый вечер (every evening) = habitual. Imperfective: смотрела, not посмотрела.
Долго (for a long time) = process/duration = imperfective: строил.

errorCorrection.sentence: Она уже готовила ужин, можно есть.
errorCorrection.hint: Уже + можно есть (can eat) = the food is done = perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: The food is ready (result) = perfective: приготовила.

sets.title: Prefix Practice
sets.description: Add the correct prefix to form the perfective verb
sets.descriptionRussian: Добавьте правильную приставку для образования совершенного вида

items.explanation: Готовить → приготовить. The pure prefix for готовить is при-.
Смотреть → посмотреть. The pure prefix for смотреть is по-.

items.prompt: проверить → this verb already has a prefix. Is it perfective or imperfective?
items.hint: It has the prefix про-. Its pair is проверять.
items.explanation: Проверить is perfective (prefix про-). Its imperfective pair is проверять.

blanks: Я хочу _____ эту книгу до конца. (I want to read this book to the end.)
Нужно _____ домашнее задание. (You need to do the homework.)
Мы хотим _____ этот фильм. (We want to watch this film.)
Она решила _____ торт. (She decided to bake a cake.)
hints: Read to the end = completion = perfective of читать.
Need to complete = perfective of делать.
Want to watch (a single film) = perfective of смотреть.
Decided to bake (one cake) = perfective of печь.
explanations: Until the end = completion: прочитать (про- + читать).
Bake one cake: испечь (ис- + печь). Irregular prefix.

sets.title: Pure Pair or New Verb?
sets.description: Distinguish pure aspect pairs from prefixed verbs with changed meaning
sets.descriptionRussian: Отличите видовую пару от нового глагола с изменённым значением

items.prompt: писать → записать. Is записать the perfective pair of писать?
options: No, записать means 'to write down' (different meaning)
items.answer: No, записать means 'to write down' (different meaning)
items.hint: Записать adds a new meaning, not just completion.
items.explanation: Записать means 'to write down/record,' not just 'to finish writing.' The pure pair is написать.

items.prompt: читать → перечитать. Is перечитать the perfective pair of читать?
items.explanation: Перечитать means 'to reread.' The pure pair of читать is прочитать.

items.prompt: строить → построить. Is построить the perfective pair?
options: No, it has a different meaning
items.hint: По- here is the pure prefix for строить.
items.explanation: Построить is the pure perfective pair: it means 'to build (and finish),' same meaning as строить but completed.

items.prompt: делать → переделать. Is переделать the perfective pair?
items.explanation: Переделать means 'to redo.' The pure pair of делать is сделать.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ все слова из текста. (He wrote out all the words from the text.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote out/copied all the words. (выписать = to write out)
minimalPairs.explanation: Выписать (вы- + писать) = to write out/extract. Different meaning from написать (pure pair).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ длинное письмо. (He wrote a long letter.) - completed
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote a long letter. (finished writing it)
minimalPairs.explanation: Написать = perfective pair of писать (to write). He finished writing the letter.

translation.hint: built (completed) = построили, new school (acc.) = новую школу

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round combining prefix pairs, aspect choice, and context
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: приставки, выбор вида и контекст

items.prompt: Мы _____ эту песню много раз. (We sang this song many times.)
items.promptEnglish: We sang this song many times.

items.prompt: Он быстро _____ задачу. (He quickly solved the problem.)
items.hint: Quickly solved = single completed action = perfective.
items.explanation: Single completed action: решил (perfective). Решить from решать.

items.prompt: Мама каждый день _____ обед. (Mom cooks lunch every day.)
items.explanation: Каждый день = habitual action = imperfective present: готовит.

items.prompt: Бабушка уже _____ свитер. (Grandma already knitted the sweater.)
items.promptEnglish: Grandma already knitted the sweater. (it's done)
items.explanation: Уже = completed result. Perfective: связала (с- + вязать).

errorCorrection.explanation: Обычно = habitual action = imperfective: смотрел, not посмотрел.
